references.text: The same chapter describes similar procedures for evaluating unclean animals dedicated to the Lord, where the priest is also to assess their value
Describes what happens if the person who dedicated a house wishes to redeem it again, with the addition of one-fifth of its value
Concerns laws about the redemption of houses in walled cities and villages, providing context for property regulations in Israel
Everything devoted to the Lord in Israel shall belong to the priests, illustrating the priests' role in managing holy gifts
Nehemiah describes how the people brought firstfruits and tithes to the storehouses, demonstrating the practice of dedicating property to the Lord
Describes the consecration of the tabernacle and its equipment as holy to the Lord, serving as background for the concept of dedicating things to God
